title: Perfect tour for Granada
text: The tour is a must for segway and Granada lovers. I really enjoyed the tour as it offers a different angle of the city which we could cover faster and more efficient. Ruben was our tour guide and he made the tour more interesting throughout our discussions  along the way.
author: K7408IIabdullaha

title: A Lovely Way To See Granada!
text:
We had a 2-hour tour with Fares as our guide and it was a really enjoyable experience. Having not visited Granada previously, this was a fantastic way to see the some of the major sights in just a few hours (and saved a lot of walking up/down some steep hills!).
Fares was a great guide and gave us a lot of useful info about the city during our tour.
Thanks, Fares and TopSegway - keep up the good work!
author: DrewdBoy

title: Fabulous Tour on Seway!
text: We were so lucky to get Simon for our guide. He was fabulous! Given the length and quality of our guide it was money very well spent (especially as I got a Blue Light discount through Viator!). Fortunately, we were the only ones who had booked that particular slot, so it was a private tour, just for myself, my husband and daughter! Simon was really patient at teaching us how to use the Segways and kept an eye on us throughout the tour, so it felt like a very safe experience. title: I must when visiting Granada
text:
Simon our guide was absolutely amazing, very knowledgeable and so kind to our nervous daughter during the teach, before we ventured off. This is so worth the money, I would say an absolute must when visiting Granada. You will see and go places you just would not see otherwise.
Simon, you made our trip to Granada, thank you.
